         All Work and No

         Give your Chapter some good live en -
         tertainment at the close of your bus-
         iness meetings.
         The Chapter Service Bureau of the
         Izaak Walton League is adding new
         films of fishing , hunting, reforesting,
         camping, wild life, etc. Thirty addi-
         tional reels will be ready by Sept . 15 th .
         Each state has splendid speakers, either
         business or professional men , who are
         available at all times. These speakers are
         well qualified to entertain and instruct.
         A good national speaker is not beyond
         the means of any Chapter and will put
         money into your treasury. Among our
         national speakers are El Comancho,
         Frank Branch Riley, Jack Miner , Dr.
         Ruskin , “ Rocky Mountain Bill ” Stroud ,
         Dr . Walter McPherson, Wm . L. Finley
         and Lewis R . Freeman . The appearance
         of any one of these men will be met
          with great favor in your community.
          Next season' s program should be arranged now
                 Write today for full particulars

                  Chapter Service Bureau

     Izaak Walton League of America
              536 Lake Shore Drive , Chicago , Illinois
